title: A strongly measurable, everywhere-bounded modification of an a.e. dual-norm-bounded n-vector field
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) a μ-a.e. strongly measurable field of n-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and all n-covectors α (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm). Then there is a strongly measurable ζ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) with |ζ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every x ∈ ℝ^P and every n-covector α, and ζ = ξ μ-a.e.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n, StronglyMeasurable ζ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ζ =ᵐ[μ] ξ
